summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K to disclose a local bond placement on May 20, 2026. The bank issued Series BF bonds (ticker BSTDBF0325) for a total amount of Ch$ 10,500,000,000 pesos with a maturity date of September 1, 2031, and an average placement rate of 6.00%. The bonds were placed using a shelf registration (line of credit number 20240007) registered with the Chilean Financial Markets Commission. This is a routine debt offering in the local market, not a special situation transaction. No change of control, merger, acquisition, activist, or restructuring elements are present. There is nothing to watch from a risk-arb perspective.
